messages:
emma: quick sync — I opened a lightweight PR that updates the tiered pricing page with the new metering semantics. need a thumbs on the sample snippets + dashboard panel link :eyes:
raj: linking now. are we keeping the old header examples or replacing with the v2 header?
olivia: replace with v2, but keep a migration note for customers on Dedicated/Private. they need the compatibility matrix.
james: confirmed — pricing will still show legacy tiers until 2026-06-01, so add a banner and a short migration checklist. also add an example for burst credit calculations (small code sample).
lisa: code sample suggestion: show token-metering header + client-side calculation for burst credits, then show how the dashboard maps that to the "consumption" metric. put JS + Python snippets.
emma: perfect. draft snippet (JS):
```js
// add X-Redwood-Metering header with tier info
fetch('/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer $TOKEN',
    'X-Redwood-Metering': 'tier=pro;burst=500'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({prompt: 'Summarize this...'})
});
```
emma: and Python example too:
```py
import requests
headers = {
  'Authorization': f'Bearer {TOKEN}',
  'X-Redwood-Metering': 'tier=pro;burst=500'
}
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', headers=headers, json={'prompt': 'Summarize this...'})
```
raj: these look good. can you also add the snippet showing the dashboard query (Prometheus/SQL) mapping? small example for the docs panels.
olivia: yeah add a Grafana panel query sample for the "metered_consumption" timeseries and a note: "use per-route label to split by endpoint".
james: request: include a short worked example calculating monthly spend: show tokens -> metered units -> price per unit -> monthly estimate. folks in sales are going to link to this.
emma: will add the worked example table and a short paragraph on rounding rules (we round up to the nearest 1k tokens for pricing). also adding a migration note about quotas — existing quota headers will be honored until cutoff.
lisa: on the PR itself, I noticed a bad link to the billing dashboard (old path). please replace with /console/usage/tiered-metering (I can patch).
docs-bot: created docs ticket DOCS-4727 for the migration banner + snippets (assignee: emma).
emma: thanks @docs-bot — I’ll push updates today. last ask: can an eng reviewer validate the header behavior for Dedicated? lisa, can you confirm before I merge?
lisa: will validate on Dedicated tomorrow morning and post a quick result here. if all good, we can merge and cherry-pick to stable branch. :thumbsup:
raj: once merged i'll update the SDK examples page to include the v2 header with the same wording.
emma: timeline: aiming to merge by EOD. if anyone needs to block, flag within the next 4 hours. cheers! :rocket:
